theorems.name: Submission.dtc_blowUp_algebra
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam), (∀ (n : ℕ) (S T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), blowUp (S - T) x lam hlam.ne' = blowUp S x lam hlam.ne' - blowUp T x lam hlam.ne') ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) (S T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), blowUp S x lam hlam.ne' = blowUp T x lam hlam.ne' → S = T) ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), (blowUp T x lam hlam.ne').support = dilation x lam '' T.support) ∧ ∀ (m : ℕ) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), (blowUp T x lam hlam.ne').boundary = blowUp T.boundary x lam hlam.ne'
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
